text:
marta: flagging a regression after the kernel-selector push: host CPU on proxy nodes climbed and p99 tokenize time increased. flame points to tokenize + many small grpc writes. sharing quick notes. anyone free to look? :frowning:
dan: which cluster? paste flame/top stacks and any syscall counts. my gut says write coalescing not firing or flush sites changed.
marta: eu-south proxies. flame top: 
```
  48% host::tokenize_and_pack
  31% net::grpc::emit_writev_small
  11% parse::stream_split
  10% kernel::fallback_variant
```
Syscalls: writev ~10 calls per 1KB output. lots of 128B-256B frames.

zhou: also seeing kvcache hit-rate dip and eviction spikes around same window. could be batch window shrinking under load so prefixes miss the cache.
dan: did you try toggling the new kernel flag or widening batch.window_ms? Also check `stream_coalesce` and any explicit flushes in tokenizer.
marta: quick canary with selector_mode=eager + batch.window_ms=4 reduced small-req CPU ~-7% but long-seq p99 increased +3.5%. kvcache hit 0.82->0.69 at peak, evictions/sec 340->1200. writev per-req short 13->4, long 22->31.

zhou: sounds like the eager selector moves serialization earlier which helps tiny flows but delays cache warmup for long flows. microbatching might help. propose test matrix: (selector on/off) x (window_ms 4/16) + microbatch(count=3,max_delay_ms=6). run mixed synthetic 95% short/5% long and capture p50/p95/p99 cpu, writev/syscalls/request, kvcache histos, flames.
dan: +1. also add a microbench to measure serialize_ns per kernel variant and a perf CI gate.

infra-bot: spawned canary group canary-6565656600 for matrix run.

perf-bot: perf runs posted: https://perf.internal/runs/65656566 (CSV + flame tar).

marta: initial matrix sample: window_ms=16 + selector=eager improving mixed p99 by ~-5% and halving evictions; microbatch reduced writev churn but added ~1.0ms p50 for tiny bursts.

zhou: ok to recommend interim flags: `selector_mode=eager`, `batch.window_ms=16`, `microbatch(count=3,max_delay_ms=6)`, keep `stream_coalesce=true`. I'll add serialize microbench and CI check.
dan: file a PERF ticket with hypotheses, attach flames/CSVs, and include rollback steps for kernel-selector rollout.
marta: filing PERF-7738 and will update with full CSVs. thanks all. :thumbsup:
